# Review Checklist: Push Manager Check 2 — One-Line README Comment

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the spec and plan before implementation (standard depth, PR reviewer audience)
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is "comment" defined precisely enough to rule out visible text (hidden source comment vs. visible sentence)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK002 Is the comment wording constraint ("short", "mentions the push manager check") specific enough for two implementers to produce equivalent results? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK003 Is "end of the README" defined for a file with or without a trailing newline? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK004 Is "exactly one new line" clear about whether a separating blank line counts as an added line? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK006 Is the placement in the Assumptions consistent with the edge case forbidding code blocks and list items, given the README's last element? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK007 Does the plan's chosen comment text satisfy FR-003 as written in the spec? [Consistency, Plan §Summary] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
